items.title: Nvidia is about 6% of the S&P 500. If Jensen Huang is ousted, there’s no clear successor — could chaos hit portfolios?
items.summary: An Nvidia leadership shake-up could send shockwaves through the market — and analysts are looking ahead to glean how much investor portfolios could be at risk.

items.title: The race is on to sue Nvidia
items.summary: Nvidia’s stock slid more than 4% after its board opened an investigation into Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, and one securities law expert says the company’s earlier insistence that it was all “normal” could turn into a very expensive problem.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway May Have Sold More Bank of America Stock in the Third Quarter
items.summary: Berkshire’s quarterly filing offers clues to possible Bank of America sales and additional Alphabet purchases ahead of its portfolio disclosure.
